notes.title: Patch Notes: Introducing Boss Levels
notes.content:
Thank you all for the humongous response. This a surprise update for all CUBOTS THE ORIGINS players. 

- Introduced 2 new boss levels.
- Added extra bolts.
- Enemy Difficulty Reduced from level 08 to level 13.
- Changed Enemy design textures.
- Fixed minor bug issues.
- Added new obstacles.

Have fun and Keep supporting us!

With love,
Team Street Lamp Games.
